title: Degree of a sum of ANF coefficients
statement:
Let $n\in\mathbb N$, and let $c,d$ assign an element of the field with two elements to each subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$. The algebraic degree of their pointwise sum, computed in that field, is at most the maximum of their algebraic degrees:
\[
\deg(c+d)\le\max\{\deg(c),\deg(d)\}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: $c,d$ assign coefficients in the field with two elements to every subset of $\{1,\ldots,n\}$
